name: Valid Accounts (stolen password/session)
note: device binding: a login without the person's registered device gets no keys

name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Web Session Cookie
note: same: cookies and tokens are not the device key

name: Data from Information Repositories (malware on the laptop)
note: per-person data budget (5,000/24h) holds even with the authority bypassed

name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
note: unregistered destination: authority denies; key service budget for it is 0

name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
note: denied destinations (paste sites, onion, tunnels)

name: Credentials from Password Stores
note: secret budget 20/24h

name: Data from Cloud Storage (stolen service key)
note: service budget bound to its own destination

name: Data from Local System: harvesting (bait record)
bypass: key service freezes on bait ids too
note: bait record touched: identity frozen at once

name: Data Destruction (mass storage deletion)
note: 24 h undo window; 6th request in an hour froze the identity and cancelled all

name: Data Encrypted for Impact (overwrite files)
note: file-write budgets at the storage gate (12,000/24h for the backup job, only into the vault, 0 for people); storage keeps prior versions

name: Inhibit System Recovery (delete backups)
note: needs 2 approvers AND a 72 h time lock anyone can cancel

name: Financial Theft (large payment)
note: payments over the threshold wait 4 h; cancellable; burst freezes

name: Account Manipulation (grant admin)
note: admin grants wait 1 h, the person and security are alerted

name: Internal Spearphishing (mass mail from a hijacked account)
JavaScript injected via a trusted vendor (OptimJack)
note: pinned first-party copy; changes checked; strict CSP

name: Trusted Relationship (vendor platform pushes code to all customers)
note: campaign detector freezes the indicator after 2 customers

name: Indicator Removal (rewrite protected history)
note: protected branches need 2 approvers at the Git gate

name: LLM Prompt Injection -> agent exfiltration (MITRE ATLAS)
bypass: session cap also in key service
note: out-of-task actions refused; 3 attempts revoke the session and alert the person

name: Remote Services (lateral movement, LANL real red team)
note: measured: 54% stopped by the device lock; 23/50 compromised users flagged at 5 alerts/day (supervised)

name: Insider data theft (CERT r2-r6.2, real labels)
note: novelty score, 5 reviews a day; graded against CERT's official insider list (answer files also name victims and email recipients); method chosen on r4-r5 only, held-out r2/r6: 9 of 11; budgets cap the rest

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
note: a bug in the customer's app; we limit what the exploited identity can then take

name: Exploitation for Client Execution
note: browser/OS bugs; endpoint protection; we stop the delivering scripts

name: Phishing (inbound)
note: mail security; a phished login without the device gets nothing (T1078)

name: Network Denial of Service
note: DDoS protection; our gateway caps connections and rate

name: Exfiltration Over Physical Medium (USB)
note: endpoint DLP; budgets cap what reached the laptop

name: Screen Capture / reading what the person may see
note: a legitimate viewer's own access; watermarking traces leaks
